feature_definitions.step_type: step within the follow-up chain (e.g. result_reviewed)
feature_definitions.responsible_role: role responsible for completing the obligation
feature_definitions.origin_encounter_type: encounter type of the originating encounter (or 'none')
feature_definitions.origin_department: department (or encounter class) of the originating encounter (or 'none')
feature_definitions.chain_length: number of obligations in the chain
feature_definitions.window_hours: hours between obligation creation and deadline
feature_definitions.n_incomplete_dependencies: direct dependencies without completion evidence at assessment_time
feature_definitions.n_incomplete_ancestors: all transitive ancestors without completion evidence at assessment_time
feature_definitions.parent_state: none | completed | pending (state of the direct parent(s) at assessment_time)
feature_definitions.hours_since_parent_completed: hours since latest direct parent completion evidence (NaN if none)
feature_definitions.n_events_so_far: events on this obligation and its ancestors up to assessment_time
feature_definitions.hours_since_last_event: hours since the latest such event (hours since creation if none)
feature_definitions.no_events_yet: 1 if there is no event on the chain yet
feature_definitions.has_scheduled_appointment: an appointment_scheduled event exists on the chain
feature_definitions.appointment_minus_deadline_hours: scheduled appointment time minus deadline, hours (NaN if none scheduled)
feature_definitions.has_conflicting_record: a conflicting secondary record exists so far
feature_definitions.evidence_uncertainty: (unverified + conflicting) / events so far (0 if none)
feature_definitions.has_documented_source_evidence: chain includes a documented source-dataset event
feature_definitions.extraction_confidence: confidence of the originating extraction (1.0 for structured/documented)
feature_definitions.prior_n_due: patient's other-chain obligations already past deadline at assessment_time
feature_definitions.prior_n_completed_ontime: of those, completed on time per evidence available at assessment_time
feature_definitions.prior_completion_rate: Laplace-smoothed on-time completion rate of prior obligations
feature_definitions.prior_noshow_count: documented no-show events for the patient so far
feature_definitions.n_concurrent_open: patient's other open obligations (created, not past deadline, no completion) at assessment_time
feature_definitions.n_concurrent_open_same_role: same, restricted to the same responsible role
feature_definitions.role_handoffs: number of responsible-role changes along the chain up to this obligation
feature_definitions.n_encounters_since_origin: patient's encounters after the originating encounter up to assessment_time
feature_definitions.n_department_transitions_since_origin: of those, encounters in a different department/class than the origin

binary_target: label_binary (1 = overdue_unresolved, 0 = completed); unverified & censored_or_unknown are excluded from binary training
assessment_rule: assessment_time = created + U(0.2, 0.8) * (deadline - created), seeded per obligation; only obligations without completion evidence at assessment_time are included
excluded_demographics: age/sex/race are deliberately NOT features (bias risk, not needed)
